card.name: Units right after a quantity, before change words
card.fires_on: The unit or measure word right after a number, such as hours, -degree, %, points, mmHg or increase, when it is followed by a change word like higher, earlier, decrease or reduction.

modes.label: Unit after number
modes.description: A unit word or symbol directly follows a number and leads into a comparison.
modes.example: which is 7<< hours>> earlier than CET

modes.label: Change word after percent
modes.description: The word increase follows a percentage and describes a change in a measured value.
modes.example: produced an 85%<< increase>> in the mean C max and AUC

modes.label: Percent or mmHg ending
modes.description: The last part of a measure such as mmHg or % is followed by decrease or reduction.
modes.example: a 35 mm H<<g>> decrease in systolic blood pressure

card.writes: It nudges the next word toward direction and extent words like toward, over and sustained, and away from fractions such as half or completely.
card.plain: It fires on the unit just after an amount, when the text is about to say how much something rose, fell or differed.
